newsitem.title: USA: Video Update adds 11 video superstores.
newsitem.headline: Video Update adds 11 video superstores.

text.p: Video Update Inc said on Thursday it has added eleven video superstores bringing its total number of Video Update superstores to 268.
This total includes eight new company-built stores opened in existing markets in October as well as acquisitions in Missouri, Minnesota and Washington.
Terms of the acquisitions were not disclosed.
"We are moving ahead aggressively with our expansion plans through both new store builds and strategic acquisitions," said Dan Potter, chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Of the 268 video superstores, 240 are corporate-owned and 28 are franchised.
Shares of Video Update were trading up 2/16 to 3-15/16.
